dp2e9w34.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Brown - 151 cm
dp2e9w34.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Brown - 151 cm
dp2e9w34.sourceDescription: This Modern Christmas Tree captures the essence of the festive season with a rustic elegance that suits any home. Ideal for creating a cozy ambiance, its natural teak wood gives a charmingly rugged appearance, perfect for enjoying the Yuletide spirit with family and friends. Designed for indoor and sheltered outdoor use, this decorative masterpiece is as versatile as it is beautiful, bringing joy and cheer to both living rooms and hallways. Solid Teak Wood: Crafted from solid teak wood, this Christmas tree is both sturdy and stylish. Teak wood is renowned for its durability and natural beauty, making it an ideal choice for decorative items that require both function and form. The wood's warm tones create a welcoming atmosphere, enhancing the festive mood during the holiday season. Unique Rustic Design: Emphasizing natural and rugged beauty, the rustic design of this tree adds a timeless appeal to any decor. Its minimalist approach complements modern interiors while providing a nostalgic touch that evokes the essence of Christmas. It serves as a centerpiece, inviting admiration from guests and family alike. Durable Stand: The robust teak wood stand ensures the tree remains sturdy throughout the festive period. Its abrasion-resistant finish prevents wear and tear, while the brown hue harmonizes with traditional holiday decorations. This sturdy base offers stability, providing peace of mind when entertaining during the holidays. Versatile Placement: Perfect for living rooms and hallways, this tree adapts easily to various spaces and decorating themes. Its understated elegance allows it to blend seamlessly with different settings, adding a touch of holiday cheer without overwhelming the surroundings. Simple Maintenance: Maintain the tree's beauty by wiping it with a dry cloth to remove dust and restore its luster. This ensures its charm remains intact year after year, allowing you to enjoy the holidays without a hassle. Product Specifications Colour: Brown Material: Solid teak wood Tree height: 151 cm Stand size: 50 x 50 cm Durable Easy Setup Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Wooden Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
